materials.title: Power Games: Rules and Roles in Second Life

sessions.description:
Interactive Role Play
A type of role playing game in which each participant assumes a particular character and acts out various scenarios at events which last for a predetermined time

activities.description: Using what we have learned throughout the course, we will create a role play scenario in which each student in the course will be designated a role, and using certain rules, we will act them out in a collaborative experiment.

sessions.description:
Discussion on Yesterday’s Role Play
Power dynamics, strictness of the rules, how can we analyze what happened, how much was planned, was it a success or failure.
What reflections do we have on this experiment keeping in mind the things that we learned through the 5 weeks

Recap on the course
Reflections, critiques, etc.
